text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I wonder if the cause is... that after all...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would you like some tea?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I added a little bit of honey to your usual herbal tea.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Lately—I've really gotten into it.
Depending on the flowers and where it was harvested...
the flavor and fragrance change, which is so fascinating—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
How is it? I tried blending a few citrus honeys
that would complement the tea, but...
choice_data_list: I see! No wonder it's so delicious.
I see! No wonder it's so delicious.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad it was to your liking.
There's plenty for seconds, so if you'd like—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I was just so happy... that you liked it—
that it made me want... to make you even happier...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: After that, I ended up researching tea snacks, too...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Honey scones... and honey pudding,
even a honey nut tart... ahh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I want to make them happy...
If it affects my running—it ruins everything.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I have to... take it back.
...Even more...!

As a result of quietly and earnestly
working on her diet, Curren Bouquetd'or's
weight returned to normal.
